article.title: Conversion from unlisted public company into limited liability partnership.
article.content:
57Conversion from unlisted public company into limited liability partnership.

Section 57  ·  Chapter X  ·  page 22 of the Act
An unlisted public company may convert into a limited liability partnership in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter and the Fourth Schedule.
